what_the_data_does_buy.caveat: threshold swept on the scoring split; confirm on a fresh slice before shipping

conclusion: self-learning on this head's weights is closed: it is converged and the reachable headroom is an artifact of in-sample counting. The productive loop is (1) fit the consult gate on outcomes, (2) buy FEATURES, since the hidden layers resolve no more than the 42 inputs already do.
